confirmation_rule: all-layer held-out curves are saved for transparent diagnostics, but the programmed winner reads discovery columns only; the reported selected row is therefore discovery-frozen

estimands.final_count: decodability of gold N=1..10 at the prompt-final Total: query state versus the thinking-trace token immediately before the numeric final answer
estimands.running_index: decodability of k=1..10 from non-thinking prompt occurrence states versus native-thinking parsed thinking-trace item states

final_count_split_caveat: both modes use the registered 20-seed discovery / 10-seed confirmation split over all ten gold-count conditions; each confirmation panel therefore contains 100 trajectories

final_count_token_sites.native_thinking: answer_query_v3: last literal thinking-trace token immediately before the numeric final answer
final_count_token_sites.non_thinking: prompt_final_total_query: final prompt Total: token immediately before answer generation

independent_layer_rule: token site and layer are selected separately within each mode; layer numbers are never matched across modes
metrics: multiclass balanced accuracy for class-weighted logistic regression and nearest centroid; class-balanced centroid signal/noise ratio in the frozen discovery projection
preprocessing: StandardScaler and whitened PCA refit inside every grouped discovery fold; the held-out projection is fit on all selection rows
running_index_analysis_unit: all 10 registered counts x 30 seeds = 300 trajectories per model; trajectory i contributes only its observed labels 1..M_i

running_index_token_sites.excluded_from_primary_search: pre_marker/marker_end and format-conditioned selectors are omitted because they mix lexical marker cues with the pooled representation estimand

native_thinking_primary.city_end: last city/entity token in a parsed trace item
native_thinking_primary.city_unit_end: last token in the sentence or physical line containing the parsed city
native_thinking_primary.item_end: last token of a completed parsed trace item
native_thinking_primary.post_boundary: first token after the parsed item boundary
native_thinking_primary.pre_city: last token before the parsed city begins; an anticipatory site for implicit lists and a sensitivity site elsewhere

non_thinking.span_end: last token of each prompt evidence span
non_thinking.span_mean: mean over tokens in each prompt evidence span

selection_rule: maximize the mean of discovery grouped-CV logistic and nearest-centroid balanced accuracy; tie-break by NCC, logistic, earlier within-model layer, then token-site name

trace_groups.marker_strata_role: descriptive appendix only; no stratum-specific site/layer winner search in the primary analysis
